# Kodera proximity frame v1: the frozen wire bytes.
#
# The proximity channel was first named `#urgence` and its frame "emergency frame v1". The name
# changed; the bytes did not. Everything a deployed peer puts on the wire or signs keeps its
# historical value: the magic still reads "KE" and the signed label is still the ASCII text
# `kodera-emergency-v1:` (`signing_label_hex` below). Renaming either is a new protocol version.
#
# Rust (`packages/kodera-rs/src/proximity_frame_vectors.rs`), Swift
# (`apps/ios/packages/KoderaDomain`) and Kotlin (`apps/android/domain`) read this file and agree
# with every line. `scripts/audit-proximity-vector.mjs` checks every signature with an
# independent Ed25519 implementation. The TypeScript codec is held to the first frame by its own
# tests (`apps/web/tests/unit/emergency/codec.test.ts`).
#
# Grammar, one entry per line, fields separated by single spaces:
#   const <name> <value>
#   frame <name> <ttl_hops> <status> <timestamp_ms> <text_utf8_hex|-> <wire_hex> <transcript_hex>
#   refuse <name> <wire_hex>
# Blank lines and lines starting with `#` are ignored. Any other line is an error.
#
# Layout of a frame (`fixed_overhead_bytes` plus the text):
#   0..2 magic | 2 version | 3..19 UUIDv7 | 19..51 sender | 51 ttl_hops | 52 status
#   | 53 text length | 54..54+N UTF-8 text | last 64 bytes Ed25519 signature
# The signed transcript is the label, then bytes 3..51, then bytes 52..54+N. `ttl_hops` is not
# signed, so a relay lowers it without breaking the author's signature.
#
# A `frame` decodes to the stated fields, encodes back to exactly `wire_hex`, and its transcript
# is exactly `transcript_hex`. Each one carries a genuine Ed25519 signature made with the
# published RFC 8032 test 1 pair; only the public half and the signatures are stored. A `refuse`
# entry must fail to decode.

const magic_hex 4b45
const version 1
const fixed_overhead_bytes 118
const max_frame_bytes 256
const max_text_bytes 138
const max_ttl_hops 6
const signing_label_hex 6b6f646572612d656d657267656e63792d76313a
